WITH dept_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    m.department,
    COUNT(mem.member_id) as member_count,
    CAST(COUNT(mem.member_id) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member WHERE link_to_major IS NOT NULL) as share
  FROM member mem
  JOIN major m ON mem.link_to_major = m.major_id
  GROUP BY m.department
),
avg_calc AS (
  SELECT 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.department) FROM member mem JOIN major m ON mem.link_to_major = m.major_id) as avg_share
)
SELECT 
  ds.department,
  ds.member_count,
  ds.share,
  ds.share - ac.avg_share as share_minus_avg
FROM dept_stats ds, avg_calc ac
WHERE ds.share > ac.avg_share
ORDER BY ds.share DESC
